packageVerification.note: All seven locally measured installer hashes and the app version match the official signed MSIX report. Windows separately verified the installed Store package, content integrity and executable signature.

checks.name: unknown-build-install-gate
checks.detail: Before allowlisting, exact-source auditing worked while the pristine archive was rejected by the installation transform.

checks.name: Windows-package-validator
checks.detail: The existing composition suite checks standalone patches, every shared-entry combination, the complete/default sets and each patch disabled from the complete set. Outputs are deterministic, unrelated entries stay exact, distinct JavaScript outputs parse, and independent/default archive, header and executable pins match.

checks.name: theme-source-and-Chromium
checks.detail: Native qBrZ palette, k1Wx document updater and t7G8 stylesheet writer; current root CSS and native shell classes. All 27 current shell stylesheet variants have identical relevant class rules. The original palette-only frame regression still reproduces; full patched layouts pass. Source-derived rendering, separate from interactive desktop acceptance.

checks.name: local-Ubuntu-26.04-WSL2-toolkit-and-native-runtime
checks.detail: Current CLI 0.167.0-alpha.4.1 reproduces the stock path, unfiltered-listing, connector-authentication and cache-location failures. Adapter, enrollment/pairing reuse, listing/filtering/pagination/reconnect, connector discovery/error and membership-persistence scenarios pass in temporary state. Source and GraphQL checks ran separately.

checks.name: stock-WSL2-app-server
checks.scope: Bundled stock CLI in temporary home/database; no user credentials.

patchDecisions.app: All eight app patches remain needed, including the project-list reset. Current exact-source revisions and fixtures follow renamed bundle paths and native functions; patch selection remains independent and memberships remain opt-in.
patchDecisions.pet: Stock still joins a Windows home using POSIX semantics. Discovery, selection, installation, native collision handling and traversal rejection pass across Windows, POSIX and WSL UNC homes with the patch.
patchDecisions.sidebar: Stock retains expanded lists after closing and reopening. The patch restores five chats, allows re-expansion and leaves the other project expanded. Current tests also execute the new native repair callback on both toggle paths.
patchDecisions.runtime: All four runtime patches remain needed with the changed bundled CLI. Native stock-versus-adapter regressions pass; no obsolete custom CLI or user-state changes are introduced.
patchDecisions.security: Native workspace/provider restrictions, explicit authorization denials, Work/API-key identities, account-switch protection, latest disables, remote audio denial and active-turn protection remain covered. Upstream replaced the old desktop Work HTTP helper with backend-auth presence and abort checks; source tests exercise that current native callback directly and retain the old helper tests for earlier builds.
patchDecisions.fixtures: Isolated sync tests replace only the inline callee; integration tests execute its native body. Pipe tests inject the existing ensure/configuration dependency. The theme fixture executes current native palette, document and stylesheet functions with palette/account-color dependencies supplied by the fixture.
patchDecisions.retired: GraphQL shell guard and pet-home aliases remain retired. Current stock commands preserve query variables and apostrophe arguments across Windows Node and wsl.exe without external requests.

proposal.note: The original Windows module tests and actual WSL2 guest setup passed, but changed source targets blocked composition and caused source/GraphQL checks to fail. Native runtime regressions passed. The original candidate remains unchanged as historical evidence.

limitations: No generated app copy was activated; the app was not restarted and saved settings/data were not changed.
Current-build Application Control permission, startup, desktop theme, interactive pets, actual agent Browser/Computer Use, authenticated connector inventory and real-phone reconnect remain pending.
Existing Application Control and initial theme-mismatch observations remain recorded. Android project-label display remains a separate accepted limitation.
Local WSL2 passes do not establish a hosted WSL2 pass for this Store build.
